headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: Sends the site's own address as Referer with every picture, so covers and pages load from its CDN. POST_TYPE is the WordPress post type of titles, COVER_ATTR the image attribute that held a real address on the home page, CHAPTERS_VIA how the theme serves chapter lists.

getPopular.title: Popular
getPopular.text: Asks the theme's load-more endpoint (admin-ajax.php, action madara_load_more) for one page sorted by views. Each card is .page-item-detail with the title link in .post-title a and a lazy-loaded cover.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: The same load-more call sorted by the last update (meta key _latest_update).

search.title: Search
search.text: Loads the site's search page (?s=words&post_type=…) page by page and reads its .c-tabs-item__content cards, which look like the home cards.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: Reads the name from .post-title, the cover from .summary_image, the description from .summary__content, and author, genres and status from the theme's post-content rows.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: Posts to the title's ajax/chapters/ (or admin-ajax.php with the post id on older themes) and reads li.wp-manga-chapter rows: link, text as title and number, date from .chapter-release-date. Addresses stay absolute, like the APK's.

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: Loads the chapter with ?style=list so every picture is in one page and reads the images of .reading-content through their lazy-load attribute.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the shared load-more POST, the card parser, absolute addresses, the cover attribute fallback chain and the first number of a chapter title.
